notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (p5), which is net of the Eliminations column (204,450 of interfund transfers removed from both receipts and disbursements), so transfers_in/out are null at top level; the Total column ties 15,925,729 + 17,938,565 - 16,815,248 = 17,049,046. Sale of property/insurance proceeds 5,368 split using General Fund schedule (p8). In detail, the General Fund budget schedule (p8) is used for General Fund revenue; for expenditures the object-level 'Cash Disbursements for Operational Expenses - General Fund' schedule (report pp59-62, trimmed pp14-17, added by the v8 re-trim) replaces its 13 function-only program lines (each program subtotal equals the p8 line; 'Adjust to budget filed with state' lines have no actual and are omitted, budget_final from the Budget 'Unaudited' column). The p8 'Pupil transportation' (412,467) and 'State categorical programs' (40,626) include 54,450 and 20,000 transfers to Depreciation Fund (74,450 total, shown as eliminations p5), recorded as contra expenditure lines plus other financing lines under the budget schedule (the 54,450 is probably Pupil Transportation - Special Education Bus acquisition, p17; no object line matches the 20,000); 130,000 Transfer to Activity Fund is printed inside total disbursements and recorded as other financing; General expenditure total 14,720,159 (p8, also p17) includes these transfers and counts the object-level schedule via includes_schedules. Software, textbooks and library books counted as supplies; mileage to parents and dues as travel. Necessary cash reserve line (budget only, 2,854,207) omitted. Federal and state categorical programs counted under instruction (statement of activities lists them separately). Business-type: Nutrition Fund cash 307,204 + receipts 556,626 (operating 553,918 + interest 2,708) - disbursements 685,638 = 178,192. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1); restricted cash categorized as restricted assets; accumulated depreciation negative within capital assets. Component unit (Foundation) excluded. Read pages 1-17 of 17
